explanationMd: The logarithms require x > 1. Combine them to get log₂(x² − 1) = 3, hence x² − 1 = 8 and x = ±3. Only x = 3 satisfies the domain. Then log₂2 + log₂4 = 1 + 2 = 3.

distractorRationale.b: This solves the combined algebraic equation but violates the logarithm domains.
distractorRationale.a: The product of the logarithm arguments is three, not eight.
distractorRationale.e: The argument product becomes fifteen rather than eight.
distractorRationale.d: This forgets the subtraction of one in (x − 1)(x + 1).
